name: Traversal verbs
notes: A capability may grant a climb difficulty (climbDifficulty, mw-e10.9): the hardest climb its holder attempts, 1 (ladders, ropes, ivy) with none, 2 rough stone and timber, 3 sheer faces; the thief's verb.climb.rough reaches 3, so a knight stops at 1 and is told so. Climbing and ledge capabilities the sim checks today (src/sim/climb: surfaces.ts and mantle.ts name these ids). Mantling and ladders, ropes and ivy need none. Every class starts with verb.climb.ledge and the thief also with verb.climb.rough (class data, mw-e19.4); until class selection applies them (mw-e19.5) the testbed grants verb.climb.ledge to the player.

capabilities.name: Ledge Hang
capabilities.description: Grab a ledge up to hand reach, hang from it, shimmy along it and lower off an edge into a hang (mw-e02.12).

capabilities.name: Climb Rough Stone
capabilities.description: Jump at a rough stone or timber wall and climb it (mw-e02.13).

capabilities.name: Climb Sheer Faces
capabilities.description: Climb a sheer face with claws or a climbing tool (mw-e10). Nothing grants it yet.

capabilities.name: Grip Ice
capabilities.description: Keep hold of a frozen surface or ledge instead of slipping off (ice tools, future). Nothing grants it yet.
